model.name: ptyBridge.reapOrphans
model.description: Server-boot lifecycle: PtyBridge reaps ALL stale sm_* grouped tmux sessions at boot. At boot NO pty is attached (the prior node process died), so every sm_* grouped session is an orphan and safe to kill-session. Complement of the per-ws detach-cleanup (AC-no-disrupt) for the restart/crash case where cleanup never fires (tmux session outlives the node process). Third R31.4 UC (server lifecycle) alongside paneTerminal.attach (fa1845d3) + paneTerminal.mount (8f3bf119). Rides Class PtyBridge 59648f26. Expert self-audit finding.
